subject.title: fix(control-ui): resolve Personal card avatar 401 via data URI

question: Should maintainers keep this narrower, conflicting PR as a landing candidate, or consolidate the linked avatar-401 work on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97634 after its blocker is repaired?
rationale: Automation can identify the compile blockers, but choosing the landing vehicle across overlapping open PRs requires maintainer routing because the broader PR has proof and coverage but also an unresolved SDK-surface review finding.

options.title: Consolidate on the broader PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97634 as the canonical path after its SDK-surface blocker is fixed, preserving this PR as source context until maintainers decide whether to close it.

options.title: Repair this narrower PR
options.body: Ask the contributor or an adopted repair lane to rebase onto current main, fix the type/lint blockers, and add real browser proof before reconsidering it as the landing path.

recommendation.title: Consolidate on the broader PR
